product_overview: Zorvyn is a lightweight client-side finance dashboard that helps users track balances, manage transactions, and surface actionable spending insights using interactive charts and local persistence.
core_goals: Provide an immediate, visually clear snapshot of a user's financial health via summary metrics and charts.
Enable fast, offline-capable transaction management (add/edit/delete) with powerful local filtering and sorting.
Surface month-over-month insights and anomaly alerts to help users make smarter spending decisions.
Offer ergonomic UI controls for theme preference and simple role-based view modes (Admin/Viewer).

features.name: Dashboard Viewing
features.description: At-a-glance financial overview including summary metrics, a balance trend chart, a spending donut breakdown, and a recent transactions preview.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View overview summary cards showing total balance, income, and expenses with trend indicators -> View balance trend chart and observe historical trend lines -> Hover over spending donut chart slices to see tooltip details -> View recent transactions list showing the latest entries
Navigate to / -> Observe empty or low-data state when there are no or very few transactions -> See guidance prompt to add transactions to populate charts and recent activity

features.name: Transaction Management
features.description: Create, edit, delete, and filter transactions with form validation, inline confirmations, and dynamic filtering/search to locate items quickly.
user_flows: Navigate to /transactions -> Initiate adding a new transaction -> Fill in description, amount, category, type, and date -> Submit transaction -> See the new transaction appear in the transactions list

Navigate to /transactions -> Initiate adding a new transaction -> Leave required field(s) empty or enter an invalid amount -> Submit transaction -> See validation error messages -> Correct the invalid fields -> Submit transaction -> See transaction saved

Navigate to /transactions -> Locate the target transaction in the list -> Initiate editing the selected transaction -> Update one or more fields -> Submit changes -> See updated transaction values reflected in the list

Navigate to /transactions -> Locate the target transaction -> Initiate editing the selected transaction -> Enter invalid data -> Submit changes -> See validation error -> Cancel edit -> See original transaction unchanged
Navigate to /transactions -> Locate the target transaction in the list -> Initiate deletion -> Confirm deletion -> See transaction removed from the list
Navigate to /transactions -> Locate the target transaction -> Initiate deletion -> Cancel deletion -> See transaction remains in the list

Navigate to /transactions -> Use search to filter transactions by text -> Apply category and type filters and/or date range -> See table update to match filters -> Clear filters -> See full transaction list restored
Navigate to /transactions -> Apply filters that yield no results -> See a 'no transactions found' state -> Adjust or clear filters to restore results

features.name: Financial Insights
features.description: Analytical views that compare income vs expenses month-over-month, highlight top spending categories, and surface anomaly alerts with contextual tips.
user_flows: Navigate to /insights -> View month-over-month income vs expense numbers and grouped comparison charts -> View top spending category progress bars and rankings -> Read detected spending anomalies and smart tips -> Acknowledge or dismiss an anomaly alert

Navigate to /insights -> See an insufficient-data notice when history is too short to generate reliable comparisons -> Receive guidance to add more transactions or expand the date range to enable insights

features.name: Global Interactivity (Theme & Role)
features.description: Client-side toggles for Dark/Light themes and a simple role switcher (Admin/Viewer) that alters UI affordances and editing capabilities.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Toggle theme to Dark -> Observe UI switches to dark theme across the app -> Reload page -> Observe theme preference persisted
Navigate to / -> Toggle theme back to Light -> Observe UI returns to light theme
Navigate to / -> Switch role to Viewer -> Observe editing and destructive actions hidden or disabled across the app
Navigate to / -> Switch role to Viewer -> Attempt to initiate editing on a transaction -> Observe editing option is not available or disabled
Navigate to / -> Switch role to Admin -> Observe editing and destructive actions re-enabled
